dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Oh? You're here.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: I do apologize, another matter was occupying my mind just now.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What are you looking at?

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Hanfeng's Ironmongers has a long history. Ownership has been passed down from generation to generation, and today it is known as the most reputable blacksmith in the land.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: The art of forging prizes precision and diligence. The tasks of forging weapons and processing ore require a great deal of time and patience.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: To most, the sound of iron being struck with a hammer is loud and intrusive. But to those who appreciate this art form, it is like the toll of a bell. Breathtaking, and transfixing.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: The sound of metal clashing with metal causes one to fall quiet, calms one's spirit, focuses one's attention, and then, with a mind emptied of unwanted thoughts, devote oneself fully to the work at hand.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It sounds like you are talented at forging, too.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Any talent I possess comes not from natural inclination, but out of necessity. In times of war, weapons are indispensable equipment, and highly sought after.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: The wondrous ley lines of Liyue produce all manner of exquisite ore. It follows naturally that distinguished artisans and prized wares arise in response.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: But I have always thought that a craftsman's ingenuity is far more valuable than any precious stone. The most accomplished in their craft do not limit themselves to working exclusively with rare ores.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell me more about famous Liyue craftspeople.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Well, Traveler... After your long sojourn in Liyue, I trust you will have heard of the houses of Kun and Yun?

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: The house of Kun is a long-established name in the art of forging. To this day, their descendants continue their craft.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: The house of Yun did not limit themselves to this craft. They branched out into many different disciplines and districts. Their descendants today still uphold the work ethic taught within their family for generations: "Even ostensible perfection can oft be improved upon through diligence." This has contributed towards their excellence in numerous fields.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Wait... Is this the same "Yun" as in "Yun Jin"?

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Ah, so you are acquainted with Miss Yun. Yes, the talented Yun Jin of Liyue operatic fame is indeed a descendant of the historic house of Yun.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Her ancestors changed professions long ago. It was her father's generation that dedicated themselves to the performing arts. In this day and age, the Yun family's history has been forgotten, and nobody knows of the connection they once had to the art of forging.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: The evolution of families over the ages has been a profound force in shaping Liyue's history. While you're here, if you have the time, you may find learning about the human history of Liyue to be illuminating.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It seems I still have a lot to learn.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Much that you might want to know can be found in books.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Even books change over the generations, causing discrepancies between their contents and the historical facts. But books can function as a mirror for humanity. Reading is the noblest of pastimes — there is always some benefit to be derived.
